acceptanceCriteria: Outcome human rendering reads an existing close decision record only after validating decision
Valid human decisions render with localized system labels and 🔴 🟡 🟢 markers for English
and Japanese; malformed or mismatched decision records fail closed and remain visible as unknown.
Existing machine-readable Outcome JSON and persisted contract
and decision facts remain unchanged; regression tests cover valid
and required workspace quality checks pass.
goal: Project validated structured Human Decision records in the human-readable Outcome handoff without changing machine-readable facts.
intent: Make an existing close decision visible to people in Outcome output, with fail-closed validation and localized English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese labels.
outOfScope: Changing the Outcome JSON schema or persisted decision/evidence facts
Changing policy evaluation or close authorization semantics
MCP protocol redesign or global Agent/MCP configuration
Release publication or unrelated documentation restructuring
